# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_HIGH_BREAK_VOLUME_SPIKE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A break above the opening range (first 30 min) accompanied by a volume surge signals strong institutional buying and continuation. This captures early momentum driven by institutional participation after the initial range establishment.

## Mechanism

Define opening range high (ORH) as highest high from 09:30 to 10:00; if price closes above ORH on a bar and that bar's volume > 2x the average volume of the first 30 minutes, enter long at next bar open. Exit: stop at OR low (chart-stop); TP1 at 1.5R (distance entry to OR low); runner trail using premium-stop % (0.8% trailing). Regime filter: only active when VIX between 15-25 and time between 09:30-11:00; skip if VIX < 12.
